parts.visual:
Imagine a giant funnel. At the top (Top of Funnel - TOFU), 10,000 people see your funny tweet. In the middle (MOFU), 1,000 of them click the link and give you their email. At the bottom (BOFU), 10 of them actually pull out their credit card and buy the software.

The Funnel:
1. The Concept: The theoretical customer journey from total ignorance of your brand to becoming a paying customer.
2. The Leakage: At every stage of the funnel, 90% of the people leave. Marketing's job is to make the top wider. Sales's job is to plug the holes at the bottom.
parts.audio: You cannot sell a $10,000 enterprise software package to someone who just heard your name three seconds ago. You must guide them slowly down the funnel, building trust at every single stage.

questions.question: A startup sponsors a massive music festival. Their logo is everywhere. Which part of the funnel is this targeting?
options: Top of Funnel (TOFU). This is pure 'Brand Awareness'. You are not trying to sell them anything right now. You just want them to know your company exists so they recognize the name later.
questions.correct_answer: Top of Funnel (TOFU). This is pure 'Brand Awareness'. You are not trying to sell them anything right now. You just want them to know your company exists so they recognize the name later.
questions.explanation: TOFU is about volume. BOFU is about conversion.

questions.question: Listen to the Sales Director complaining about the Marketing team. What is the problem?
questions.tts_text: Marketing is giving us 5,000 leads a week, but they are all garbage! They are just teenagers downloading our free meme generator. When my sales team calls them to sell our $500 software, they hang up.
options: Unqualified Leads. The Marketing team is optimizing for 'Top of Funnel' volume to look good, but the leads have zero purchasing power. A fat TOFU is useless if the leads are not qualified for the BOFU.
questions.correct_answer: Unqualified Leads. The Marketing team is optimizing for 'Top of Funnel' volume to look good, but the leads have zero purchasing power. A fat TOFU is useless if the leads are not qualified for the BOFU.
questions.explanation: This is the eternal war between Sales and Marketing.

questions.question: What happens in the 'Middle of the Funnel' (MOFU)?
options: You ask for their credit card.

Lead Nurturing. The prospect knows who you are, but they aren't ready to buy yet. You send them case studies, invite them to webinars, and educate them on why your solution is better than the competition.
questions.correct_answer: Lead Nurturing. The prospect knows who you are, but they aren't ready to buy yet. You send them case studies, invite them to webinars, and educate them on why your solution is better than the competition.
questions.explanation: MOFU is where trust is built.

questions.question: What is an 'MQL' (Marketing Qualified Lead)?
options: A person who works in marketing.
A prospect who has engaged deeply with your marketing (e.g., downloaded a pricing guide) and fits your target demographic, meaning they are now 'warm' enough to be handed over to the Sales team.
questions.correct_answer: A prospect who has engaged deeply with your marketing (e.g., downloaded a pricing guide) and fits your target demographic, meaning they are now 'warm' enough to be handed over to the Sales team.
questions.explanation: Sales teams only want to talk to MQLs, never cold leads.
